description: Start on an inline catalog card, information focused. Read-only navigation; expanded autoplay obeys trailer settings. Never activate Watchlist or feature playback.

steps.name: 01-catalog-ratings
steps.review: Card matches neighboring poster height. Frosted glass and rim separate it from the row; outlined/filled bookmark shows known Watchlist state. Available ratings and local-only library action remain.

steps.name: 02-catalog-buttons
steps.review: Compact icon controls focus without resizing the card or overlapping adjacent shelves.

steps.name: 03-catalog-full
steps.review: Full details show headshot cast shelf. Supported trailer starts asynchronously in background; Up promotes it, Back returns to details. No expanded Trailer button.

steps.name: 04-catalog-cast
steps.review: Cast shelf scrolls horizontally; Up returns to actions. No Watchlist mutation.

steps.name: 04-catalog-back-inline
steps.review: Back returns to same inline card with information focused.

steps.name: 05-catalog-back-search
steps.review: Second Back restores original result row, position and focus without requesting or playing anything.
